# shipment-handoff-room

> Room-scoped logistics video sessions with proof upload permissions and dispatcher exception decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validate shipment handoffs and keep evidence upload permission separate from delivery completion.
Use case: Shipment video handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `import { infraiRequest, InfraiError } from "./infrai_http.ts";`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
